# Test Case Design Skill

For every acceptance criterion create test cases with ID, objective, risk, preconditions, fixture/data, steps, expected result, type, automation level and evidence. Apply equivalence partitioning, boundary-value analysis, state-transition, decision-table and pairwise techniques where useful. Include positive, negative, permission, malformed input, timeouts, provider outage, retry/idempotency and concurrency scenarios. Ensure tests fail when the behavior is broken.
